release_notes: Oracle Windows Production 18.13.56N12. Adds per-market historical calibration collection for BTC, ETH, and SOL in shadow-only mode (0% trading influence), backfills historical observations and calibration bins, and improves settled-outcome collection across all observed markets. The original prediction model and trading behavior remain authoritative while the forward calibration sample continues to mature. Preserves the existing production safeguards, portable paths, profiles, and update flow.
